lastCompletedStory.title: Port Branch-decision matrix to pure TS

nextStoryContext: decideNextAction(prd: PrdSnapshot): SupervisorAction lives in src/supervisor/decide.ts. Returns implement (with storyId), review, complete, or blocked-no-implementable. Key invariant: blocked-no-implementable fires when operator-required stories are still passes=false even if all non-operator stories pass -- the autonomous loop cannot proceed until the operator does their ceremony. Cap row: roundsCompleted >= maxRounds (default 3) returns complete regardless of lastVerdict. US-006 (runSupervisor loop) imports this to sequence workers: call decideNextAction, if 'implement' mint uuid and respawn worker, if 'review' dispatch reviewer, if 'complete' return. The storyId from decideNextAction is advisory/logging only -- the worker self-selects, so the actual completed story id comes from handoff.json/sentinel after the worker exits.
